title: Poconos, Pennsylvania
seoTitle: Charter Bus to the Poconos, Pennsylvania: Group Guide
excerpt: A charter bus to the Poconos covers ski trips, waterparks and reunions in one vehicle. What each season offers, vehicle sizing, and how to plan the drive.

heroImage.alt: Forested Pocono ridges under low cloud with a lake in the valley below

extraImage.alt: A ski lift running above snow-covered slopes at a Pocono mountain resort

body.text: The Poconos work as a group destination for a reason that has nothing to do with scenery: they are close to an enormous number of people. New York City is around ninety minutes away, Philadelphia about two hours, and Newark an hour and a quarter. That puts a four-season mountain region inside easy reach of a day trip, and a charter bus to the Poconos is how most groups take advantage of it.
Winter: the ski and snow-tubing trip

Camelback, Blue Mountain, Shawnee and Jack Frost Big Boulder between them cover everything from first-timers to people who actually ski. For a mixed group this matters — the resorts run beginner programs and snow tubing alongside the real terrain, so nobody is left in the lodge all day.

The practical advantage of a coach is equipment. Skis, boards, boots and bags go in the luggage bays instead of on laps, and the group is not trying to fit six people plus gear into a car built for five. Book early for January and February weekends; Pocono ski vehicles go before almost anything else in our winter calendar.
Summer: waterparks, lakes and the Water Gap

The indoor waterparks — Camelback's Aquatopia, Kalahari, Great Wolf Lodge — are the region's biggest summer draw for family and youth groups, and they run year-round regardless of weather, which makes them the reliable fallback for any trip.

Outdoors, the Delaware Water Gap National Recreation Area runs along the eastern edge with rafting, tubing and easy waterfall walks, Lake Wallenpaupack anchors the north, and [Bushkill Falls](/blogs/bushkill-falls-pennsylvania) is the most reliable half-day in the region for a group of mixed walking ability.
Which charter bus suits a Poconos trip

items: Forty to fifty-six: a full-size [charter bus](/fleet/charter-buses) is the workhorse for ski trips and school outings, with the luggage bays that make winter travel practical.
Twenty to thirty-two: a [mini bus](/fleet/mini-buses) suits a family reunion or a corporate retreat and reaches the smaller resort and lodge entrances more easily.
Ten to fourteen: a [sprinter van](/fleet/sprinter-vans) works for an executive offsite at one of the conference resorts.
Fourteen to forty: a [party bus](/fleet/party-buses) suits a milestone birthday or bachelor and bachelorette groups heading to the resorts.

body.text: Corporate retreats are a steady share of what we run here, and our [corporate travel](/services/corporate-travel) team handles the recurring resort routes for companies that come back each year.
The region is bigger than it looks

This catches groups out. The Poconos cover roughly 2,400 square miles, and two resorts that appear close on a map can be forty-five minutes apart on winding roads. If your itinerary involves a lodge in one place and an activity in another, check the real drive time before committing — and in winter, add to it.

Keeping the vehicle for the duration rather than booking separate transfers is usually the better arrangement for exactly this reason. Groups searching for charter bus rental near me for a Poconos weekend should price the coach staying with them; the difference is often smaller than two one-way transfers and it makes the whole trip flexible.
Autumn, and why it books first

October is the Poconos at their best and the hardest month to get a vehicle. The ridges turn completely, the driving routes through the Water Gap and along Route 209 become the attraction rather than the approach, and every senior group, church group and camera club in the north-east has the same idea in the same three weeks.

The practical consequence is that a foliage trip needs to be booked in summer. Groups that call in late September are usually looking at whatever is left rather than what they wanted, and midweek dates hold availability far longer than weekends do.

It is also the season where a coach earns its keep on the drive alone. Foliage routes are winding two-lane roads where the driver sees very little of what everybody else came for, which is a reasonable argument for handing that job to somebody being paid to do it.
Getting there

Most groups come up Interstate 80 from New Jersey and New York or the Northeast Extension from Philadelphia. We run pickups from [Stroudsburg](/locations/pennsylvania/stroudsburg), [East Stroudsburg](/locations/pennsylvania/east-stroudsburg), [Scranton](/locations/pennsylvania/scranton), [Allentown](/locations/pennsylvania/allentown) and [Wilkes-Barre](/locations/pennsylvania/wilkes-barre).
Group lodging is the other half of the booking

The Poconos are built around resorts rather than towns, which changes how a multi-day trip works. Most of the large properties handle room blocks routinely and several have conference space, so a corporate retreat or a family reunion can put lodging, meals and activities on one site and use the coach only for arrival, departure and excursions.

That is usually the cheaper arrangement as well as the simpler one. A vehicle held on standby for three days costs considerably more than two transfers plus a day trip, so it is worth deciding early whether the group genuinely needs the bus available throughout or only on specific days.

Tell us which resort when you request the price. Several of the larger properties have specific coach entrances and loading procedures, and a driver who knows to use the service entrance rather than the main portico saves the group fifteen minutes at the start and the end of the stay.
Booking the trip

Send your dates, headcount, lodging address and what the group intends to do, because a ski trip and a waterpark trip are different vehicles even at the same headcount. [Request an all-in quote](/quote) and you will usually have an itemized price back the same day, driver, fuel, tolls and taxes included.
